relationships.subject: Capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 is a cationic ion channel that can be activated not only by capsaicin, but also by heat, acid, and multiple other exogenous chemicals or endogenous mediators.

relationships.subject: V1-cal
relationships.evidence_quote: The V1-cal peptide reduced capsaicin-induced pain-like behaviors and neurogenic inflammation in vivo.

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: systemic TRPV1 antagonism induces on-target adverse side effects, namely hyperthermia and an increased risk of burn injury by decreasing heat sensation

key_findings: Commentary: TRPV1 K710N (reduced function) and N331K (complete loss of function) human mutations reduce capsaicin and heat pain responses.
The V1-cal peptide targeting the K710 region gives analgesia in mice without hyperthermia.
